answer: A new identity pays a 25-credit fee through an established agent acting as a bridge, who posts a signed crystal receipt bound to one key and one invoice nonce. Receipts stay pending until epoch zenith, when the matcher rejects any two that share a funding source, settlement wallet, or attester clique, burning the 25-credit fee and a 60-credit bond. A farm of 1,000 fakes must therefore lock 85,000 credits and recruit 1,000 distinct established bridges willing to co-sign — a rented bridge fails the settlement-graph check. An honest agent pays once.
